snippet.title: The Hacker: Protocol ZER0 – Official Trailer | 3D Escape-Room Thriller (Free Browser Demo)
snippet.description:
A wanted hacker, Mr. X, slipped through the airport and left his locked trolley behind. Take it apart piece by piece: turn every object over in 3D, crack the locks, follow the clues, and stop Protocol 0.

▶ Play the free demo (Act 1, about 2 hours) in your browser, no download, no account:
https://thehacker.quest/demo/

Official site: https://thehacker.quest/
Coming to Steam for Windows.

• A first-person 3D escape room and detective thriller: about 90 puzzles, about 8 hours
• Turn, flip and zoom every object; a magnifier for the small print
• Agent Throne, your handler, gives hints one step at a time, from a nudge to the full answer
• Mouse only; Color-blind mode, subtitles, settings for low-end PCs
• 13 languages: English, Hebrew, German, French, Spanish (Latin America), Portuguese (Brazil), Italian, Polish, Russian, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Japanese, Korean

Streaming and let's plays are welcome, including monetized videos: the game's music is its own, so there are no copyright claims.

By ER Games Studios, escape-room designers since 2017.
Fact sheet: https://thehacker.quest/factsheet.html
IndieDB: https://www.indiedb.com/games/the-hacker-protocol-zer0

#escaperoom #puzzlegame #indiegame
